## RBAC scenario

What are you trying to accomplish in Entra ID or Azure RBAC that the module does not cover today?

## Graph or ARM API

Which Microsoft Graph (v1.0 or beta) or Azure Resource Manager API does this map to? Link the

## Fit with the existing cmdlet roster

Does this extend an existing `OER` cmdlet, or does it need a new one? Check the "Available
Cmdlets" section of `README.md` and the output of `Get-OERRequiredScope` for what already exists
before proposing a new noun.

## Additional context

Anything else that helps -- links, prior art in another module, a sketch of the parameters.
